throughput.method: Three sequential fresh-browser runs, each rendered ordinary automatic app from tick0 to1320/time33s. One3s settling interval then30s quiet. No physical input, no external encoder; original production transport, one tick per advance, one outstanding request, three transfer buffers. Physics owner held all builds/native trials idle throughout. Every repeat retained. Ratio uses exact start→final reply wall interval; presented-frame count captured inside final reply task.

latencyDisposition.coldAgeExplanation: Tick0 snapshot is initialized while manual mode holds the app during harness setup. The age of that pose continues to grow before automatic start; full/cold age includes this real setup age. Warm after-tick120 and after-tick400 subsets are explicitly labeled and never replace full results.
latencyDisposition.limits: No physical inputs were made in these holds, so no input-to-applied-force or input-to-visible latency is established. Average near1× pace and~59FPS do not establish per-request/frame deadlines, bounded snapshot age, mobile performance or broad realtime qualification.

readiness.limits: SwiftShader queue failure is environment-specific. Auto fallback, explicit WebGPU failure and WebGL2 recovery are verified; capable native WebGPU hardware and real Android are untested.

model.quaternionHandling: Pinned-engine full raw Hamilton q*(0,p)*conjugate(q) formula, no normalization and no unit-only shortcut. Source mass/localCOM and exported pose components restored to f32; transform/weighted sum independently accumulated in f64. Norm drift recorded; unchanged0.1mm horizontal COM criterion.
model.formula: sum(m_i*(snapshot body-origin position + snapshot rotation * model.goldenMass.centerOfMass))/sum(m_i); positive-mass16source bodies only,9zero-mass coordinate frames excluded. f64 observation arithmetic, f32 exported poses; no body-origin-as-COM shortcut.

independentFloorlessCom.limits: Independent snapshot-derived material-COM estimate, not bit-exact cached engine COM. Model mass/localCOM are source constants; engine mass reciprocal and f32/JSON rounding can differ by tiny amounts. Browser checks0.5s and radial horizontal drift<=0.1mm; native fixture is0.75s with per-axis0.1mm and additional vertical/momentum checks. This does not replace native ballistic qualification.

nativeEvidence.limits: Native physically qualified target fixture/profile and inherited failures remain exactly as recorded by the native owner. Browser snapshots do not substitute for every800Hz native support/contact/ballistic gates.

media.inspection: Final screenshot and temporal contact sheet inspected: body continuously upright, correct Joint balance label, explicit3+1/root-correction TEST banner and simulation/wall clocks visible. Video pacing is the separate0.916× encoded observation.
